Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.2: Sign Reading 12.2. 1 Intensive sign Reading: Poem/Song/Proverbs
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign Reading 12.2. 1 Intensive sign Reading: Poem/Song/Proverbs, part of Strand 12 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four General.

Key inquiry question: Why do we enjoy sign reading poems? 2. How are poems different from stories?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign Reading 12.2. 1 Intensive sign Reading: Poem/Song/Proverbs together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration: Team works as learners sign read and role-play events in groups.

● Self-efficacy: as learners answer questions from songs, poems and taking part in role play confidently.

● Digital Literacy: learners interact with digital technology as they watch a recitation of a poem on video.

Values:
Peace: love as learners, in groups or pairs, watch a recitation of a signed poem on video

Link to other subjects:
